## source: docs [R §2a] (reload in as the safety timer: the device comes back with startup-config)
<<< sw-lab-01#
>>> configure
<<< sw-lab-01(config)#
>>> hostname sw-risky
<<< sw-risky(config)#
>>> end
<<< sw-risky#
>>> reload in 1000
% Wrong number of parameters or invalid range, size or characters entered
<<< sw-risky#
>>> reload in 00:10
<<< This command will reset the whole system and disconnect your current session. Do you want to continue (y/n) [n]?
>>> y
<<< sw-risky#
>>> reload cancel
<<< sw-risky#
>>> reload in 10
<<< This command will reset the whole system and disconnect your current session. Do you want to continue (y/n) [n]?
>>> y
<<< sw-risky#
## advance 10m
>>> show version
